title: SessionStart runs intake and writes its drafts uncommitted
goal: An async SessionStart hook runs backlog.py intake --file --hook (the offline detectors) beside the red-pipeline --hook one, which keeps reading main's pipeline: silent, bounded by a timeout, writes draft item files that stay uncommitted until /kb-backlog triage commits them, never commits or pushes; /kb-backlog triage lists intake's uncommitted drafts first; the query log digest counts the week's intake candidates by detector

gates.question: intake's ci check overruns the SessionStart budget after drift; how should the hooks run?
options: two hooks: offline intake --file --hook, and red-pipeline --hook as before
gates.recommendation: two hooks: offline intake --file --hook, and red-pipeline --hook as before
gates.answer: two hooks: offline intake --file --hook, and red-pipeline --hook as before
